Initially, we see a partially open door revealing the organized chaos within: bottles, jars, and various food items are nestled in the shelves. As the door continues to move, the perspective shifts, providing a fleeting look at the arrangement of products and the transformation of the interior from open and visible to closed and hidden. Finally, the door nears closure, the inside of the fridge becomes less and less visible, and the contents are soon to be enveloped in darkness, signaling the end of this swift and everyday action.
